title: invoice ground-truth (expected.json) schema
description: Auto-generated from analyzers/invoice/analyzer.json. Do not hand-edit; re-run build-ground-truth-schema.ps1 after changing the analyzer's fieldSchema.

InvoiceDate.description: The date the invoice was issued.

BusinessName.description: Name of the business issuing the invoice (From).

BusinessEmail.description: Email address of the issuing business.

BusinessAddress.description: Postal address of the issuing business.

BusinessPhone.description: Phone number of the issuing business, labeled 'P:' under the From section.

ClientName.description: Name of the client being billed (For).

ClientPhone.description: Phone number of the client, labeled 'P:' under the For section.

TotalAmount.description: The total amount due shown on the invoice, e.g. 1234.56.
